s.how: Arrange 200g sliced cheddar, 200g crackers and 500g mixed red and green grapes on a big board. Set it out before the opening credits. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Mix 500g beef mince with 1 egg and 40g breadcrumbs and roll into small balls. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then toss in 250ml warm sweet chilli sauce.

m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake stuffing of 150g breadcrumbs, a diced onion, sage and melted butter. Serve with cranberry sauce.

w.how: Make raspberry jelly and let it half set. Tear a sponge cake into a bowl, pour over the jelly and chill. Top with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream.

d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g sugar. Pour in 800ml hot milk and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon. Chill and serve with grated nutmeg.
